licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation is left out. Don Ottavio's part, printed in the treble clef, is written at sounding pitch (treble clef with the octave below). Bar 36 has the fermata on "l'ha!" and the printed unmeasured lead-in (four small notes) written as grace notes. In bar 21 the right hand's F is played as F natural: the print omits the natural, harmony and context confirm it. Bars 71–74 are for the piano alone. The print gives no tempo word (only "Aria."). Playback tempo: ♩ = 34 (an eighth note = 68), about 4:21, from the median track length (4:24) of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 4:34, Giulini 1959 4:21, Davis 1973 4:20, Haitink 1984 4:31, Karajan 1985 4:24).
